verdict.rationale: Clara's Card Configurations API documents merchant-category restrictions (plus time and day-of-week rules) and card spend limits with monthly, weekly, or daily reset periodicity, and cards can be locked or unlocked through the API. However, nothing documents individual-merchant restrictions or explicitly states that out-of-policy transactions are declined or auto-locked at the point of sale; enforcement is only implied. Missing for 10: per-merchant (not just MCC) restrictions, explicit documentation of real-time decline or auto-lock on out-of-policy spend, per-transaction amount caps, independent or hands-on corroboration.
